name: atseq-app-native-v1
evaluator: exact existing atseq-jsonata-v1 canonical descriptor CID and bytes; unchanged pure evaluator subset and bounds

source.root: exact canonical version-2 definition record CID
source.profile: must equal genesis application semantic CID; same-semantic activation only
source.closure: exactly target definition CBOR plus unique declared raw files; 1 root, at most 63 named files and 64 distinct blocks
source.decodedCharge: root bytes plus every named file occurrence; duplicate raw CIDs deduplicate blocks but not occurrence charge
source.files: unique safe local paths, preserved supplied file-table order and unused assets; omitted authoring table is ASCII path sorted
source.completeAdmission: verify every declared file and all schema/action/query/view/initial-state bindings; no partial action admission
source.json: strict UTF-8, no BOM/comments/trailing commas/trailing data/duplicate decoded names; owned safe JSON, safe integers, no negative zero, well-formed Unicode and existing depth/size constraints
source.parser: typed strict retained-JSON core shared with I1; identity adapter unchanged; source normative failures distinct from operational limits
source.schemas: maintained ATproto Lexicon validator, admitted subset, no coercion, duplicate document IDs or unresolved/unsupported references
source.preflight: reuse pure evaluator with placeholder state/action/query data; only typed expected data-dependent invalid-input failures may be ignored; unexpected faults stall
source.views: retained local Inlay templates/registered primitives; no network, XRPC, ambient keys or scripts; declared query references must exist

sourceLengths.sourceIdentity: raw CID authenticates exact bytes, not a transport locator or its declared length
sourceLengths.transportMetadata: untrusted or even app-authenticated locator/byteManifest length remains a hint unless this semantic contract commits that length; this contract does not add such a commitment
sourceLengths.normativeBeforeLocal: verify authentic root counts first; use actual content hash/count for lengths and actual CAR framing; no false invalid_activation from HTTP Content-Length or unpinned locator
sourceLengths.stream: bounded-memory stream/hash may verify oversized raw bytes when local storage is smaller; hash/count every listed signed block before invalidity, except decisive authenticated root/count failure; incomplete hash or missing metadata stalls
sourceLengths.corruption: wrong bytes for expected CID are unavailable, not invalid source; a larger verified body can prove normative invalidity
sourceLengths.localCapacity: only normative-admissible source may stall for smaller local retention; stream memory and transport safety limits remain operational, not replicated reasons
sourceLengths.carFraming: logical one-root CAR v1 canonical header plus minimally framed unique source blocks; charge root/header/CID/block lengths, not arbitrary HTTP padding or locator-record transport

projection.roots: full normalized documentID#definitionName; default main explicit; relative refs normalized within defining document
projection.walk: iterative worklist, each identity once; follow schema properties/items/parameters/output-schema plus ref/closed-union dependencies, not arbitrary literal strings
projection.annotations: strip only authored document/schema annotation description; preserve literal properties named description and all const/default/enum content and array order; retain original authored documents
projection.reachable: all and only reachable definitions; reject unresolved/unsupported references
projection.byteIdentity: canonical UTF-8 JSON, <=524288 bytes, canonical raw SHA-256 CID
projection.transport: full 32768-byte typed chunks except last; exact length-bearing byteManifest; manifest CID is locator, not projection identity

actionContract.record: complete version-1 content record wrapping defs#actionContract
actionContract.derive: derive exact bytes from full admitted source; supplied published contract must equal derived bytes; contract publication is not source admission
actionContract.identityChanges: fold bytes, reachable validation constraints, shared state projection or enforced authorization changes affect execution; unrelated source/title/query/view/path/table-order/initial-state changes do not
actionContract.openParticipation: skips role check only; one exact live device grant remains required

ordinaryPrecedence: selected admitted source and supported app semantics available
unknown_action in complete admitted action map
foldInput: owned authenticated payload and complete captured prior state; canonical string CIDs in metadata; no definition/service CID, actorKey, grant/epoch, authority maps, identity bytes, clock or callbacks

precedence: definition_changed for expected active source mismatch
all listed signed blocks hash-verified; missing/corrupt bytes stall
normative bounds and exact root/declared closure: invalid_activation
closed manifest profile differs from pinned application semantics: incompatible_definition
full source admission under same pinned supported semantics: invalid_activation for normative source defects
successor validates captured current state: invalid_activation for known validation rejection
atomic base recheck/persistence/commit; failure has no outcome
activation.closure: freeze exactly signed CID set; external pool cannot repair omitted dependency; complete extra/missing/invalid source is invalid_activation only after source hash availability boundary
activation.state: exact complete state-only projection bytes equal; retain current state, validate successor initial state separately, no migration
activation.failures: current-state rejection by successor is invalid_activation; incompatible semantic/state interface is incompatible_definition; missing/corrupt content or unexpected runtime faults stall
activation.authority: prior govern appointment, not owner/participation role; only effective activation changes active source/control tip; source capability cannot appoint itself
activation.races: only first same-expected activation remains eligible; stale capability/intervening entry cannot commit; no automatic replacement
activation.semanticMismatch: after complete signed-byte availability, closed manifest and normative closure checks, reject different semantic pin as incompatible_definition before parsing its unsupported programs; mixed mismatch plus bad program syntax has that reason

outcome.frameworkReason: exact native plus application reason or fold_failed/ followed by exact designated stage code; no replicated framework message; max76 ASCII bytes
outcome.producers: actual internal I2/source/fold callsites choose namespace; parsed rows or caller flags cannot mint verified outcomes
outcome.invalidFoldExtra: fold-provided source field is an invalid evaluator result: fold_failed/fold_output; a valid reason matching framework name remains fold source
outcome.noOutcome: stall/invalid history/runtime/integrity/persistence faults do not advance interpreted frontier

foldFailureStages.neverCatchAll: only typed InterpretationError at the exact designated callsite with listed code; foreign errors, engine_error/dependency_mismatch and parser/static source failures after admission are unavailable/runtime faults

atomicity: one captured coherent prior domain state, admitted active source, opaque authority and authenticated entry; eligible capability binds exact objects/frontier/request; persistence succeeds before replacing state/source/authority/outcome/indexes/frontier; no accepted-state restore from plain JSON
query: captured owned state/source/frontier; validate params/result without coercion; failure unavailable, never changes state/frontier
genesis: fully supplied invalid source rejects app creation/bootstrap, no invented genesis outcome; unavailable content/support stalls before app instance; initial authority initialized only under selected supported application semantics
support: literal independently reviewed expected native/application/evaluator CIDs, descriptors and conformance compiled into software; arbitrary archive objects, code hashes, constructors or service discovery cannot self-register support; source/build/dependency provenance separate
